repositories.description: Repository names from the stage allowlist, sorted, unique.

title: PROPOSED repositories a card chooses for its bench
description: A card's narrowing of a stage allowlist (run-checkpoint-policy.v2). It names repositories by their policy name only: never a provider, a URL or a clone identity. Absent means the card names none. Fixed once the card's bench exists.
